title: Warm-Start Continuous Optimization from Round 2 Optimum with Soft Boundaries
scientific_hypothesis: The Round 2 optimum (target_score 0.8706) represents a valid local maximum that subsequent rounds failed to maintain due to overly restrictive bounds and integer-rounding post-processing. Resuming from this point with continuous-only optimization, reduced learning rate, and soft-boundary clipping will recover and potentially exceed the Round 2 performance.
design_principle: Transfer-matrix method optimization with gradient-based thickness refinement, maintaining the proven 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology from Round 2's best candidate while improving optimizer continuity and boundary handling.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica substrate (20 finite layers total, alternating high-low index starting with HfO2)
design_variables: All 20 layer thicknesses with continuous optimization bounds
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
Maintain tightest_margin above 0.4 for fabrication tolerance
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count fixed at 20 (within 30-layer maximum constraint)
Soft-boundary clipping ±2% to maintain gradient flow
Continuous thickness values without integer rounding
theory_basis: Transfer-matrix method for planar multilayer interference
Gradient-based optimization with continuous parameter space
Quarter-wave stack modification for dual-band performance
expected_advantages: Improved optimization continuity without integer-rounding artifacts
Better gradient flow with soft-boundary clipping
known_risks: May converge to same local optimum as Round 2 without improvement
Continuous optimization may be sensitive to learning rate selection
Soft boundaries may allow thicknesses outside fabrication tolerance if not monitored
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize all 20 layer thicknesses using Round 2 best candidate values: [108.65847125490973, 56.50615602255855, 115.64930917851245, 58.85922470466126, 122.67024817006853, 61.23228869203895, 130.03615377773906, 61.40177404898979, 145.55690061479294, 62.93928341891642, 152.05974953162786, 66.95082490418632, 130.761026868516, 114.91028575947755, 115.44156456389337, 130.10712878278568, 120.17238315060555, 114.78368439440294, 52.688595724793295, 53.37932410883822] nm. Apply continuous-only gradient thickness optimizer with learning rate 1e-4. Use soft-boundary clipping at ±2% of initialization values instead of hard bounds. Evaluate dual-band objectives: mean transmittance maximization in 1000-1700 nm, mean reflectance maximization in 300-450 nm. Disable any integer-rounding post-processing. Monitor tightest_margin throughout optimization to ensure sub-wavelength phase accuracy is preserved across all 20 layers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Warm-start from Round 2's best candidate (target_score 0.8706) to recover lost performance. Rounds 3-4 regressed to ~0.80 due to overly constrained bounds and possible integer-rounding. This route applies feedback directives: continuous-only optimizer, reduced learning rate 1e-4, soft-boundary clipping ±2%, no integer-rounding post-processing.
